category_title: Elementary students with ADHD and language delay who improve concentration and social helpfulness through virtual games
scenario_title: Navigation confusion and interface frustration with English pop-ups
minimal_context: The student is using a computer mouse to click on a single OK bandage in a 3D virtual health center to complete a learning mission.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's complete the learning mission. Use the mouse to click on the single OK bandage in the health center.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Struggles to smoothly control the mouse to click the virtual object) How many questions are left to answer?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We still have a few more. Just try your best to click it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Clicks here and there on the screen, missing the bandage) A box popped up with English words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spends a lot of time staring at the English pop-up) Is this part of the learning material? (Gets stuck clicking on the unfamiliar English words instead of the bandage)
